text:
morgan: seeing a weird spike of traces where the warm-start parent span exists but none of the child spans show up. started right after the proxy deploy at ~08:12 UTC. anyone else?

anita: how many traces / what service?

morgan: checkout this trace id: 0fae3b7c9d2a4e1a - span tree shows only the http parent, no downstream db/cache spans. sampling looks fine. logs show exporter warnings: 

```
2026-05-14T08:12:23Z WARN otlp-exporter span batch dropped=42 reason="queue full"
2026-05-14T08:12:24Z ERROR sidecar OOM killer invoked
```

raj: queue full + OOM -> exporter backpressure could have caused drop, but that usually still leaves some children earlier in the pipeline. are spans getting stripped at the proxy? did the deploy change headers?

lena: fwiw the nginx ingress had a header rewrite to normalize casing for a different feature. could that have touched traceparent?

morgan: config diff shows we added `proxy_set_header Traceparent $http_traceparent;` (uppercase T) in the new patch. previously we forwarded all headers unchanged. the collector expects `traceparent` lowercase in the SDK we're using (otel-java 1.4.0). could be case-sensitivity in our sidecars.

zack: OTLP/gRPC should be header-agnostic for the wire, but the SDK's http extractor checks env var OTEL_PROPAGATORS and header lookup is a map - some middleware lowercases keys, some leaves them. if the proxy started promoting uppercase header names, our extractor might miss it.

anita: can we repro locally? morgan, can you post a curl that hits the proxy with a traceparent header?

morgan: curl example i used: 
```
curl -i -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" http://ingress.host/_health
```

morgan: response headers coming back show `Traceparent: 00-...` (uppercase) instead of `traceparent` -> looks like the nginx patch is promoting header casing.

raj: if the header arrives as `Traceparent` at the sidecar and the sdk checks lowercase `traceparent`, the propagator get returns null and the child spans are created as new rootless spans or dropped depending on the sampler. that fits symptoms.

zack: also the exporter OOM/writes could have amplified because a bunch of spans were considered unrelated and overflowed queues. two problems compounding.

lena: quick mitigation: roll the proxy patch back to preserve original header names. we can also make the collector tolerant to both cases. which is faster?

anita: rollback will be fastest to stop ongoing drops. collector patch needs a small acceptance test but should be low-risk (lookups for both `traceparent` and `Traceparent`).

morgan: oncall-bot just posted the deploy: `deploy proxy ingress v2.3.7 by ops-ci (08:11 UTC)`. devops-bot: any alerts?

devops-bot: alerts: exporter queue length spike on sidecar-set-a, cpu high, one OOM event. auto-restart happened 08:13:12 UTC.

raj: plan: 1) rollback proxy header normalization (rollback started) 2) pin otel SDK to patched 1.4.1 with more permissive header lookup 3) collector change to check case-insensitive header keys (follow-up PR).

lena: rollback in progress. I'll watch for improved traces.

morgan: after rollback, i'm seeing child spans re-appear for the previously failing trace ids. queue metrics trending back to baseline.

anita: assign a postmortem and timeline. create ticket and add links to diffs + logs.

morgan: created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-6789 with initial notes + traces. tagging for root cause: header-casing-proxy-change + sidecar-memory-pressure.

raj: one more note — the instrumentation test-suite didn't catch this because our CI uses a test proxy that lowercases headers. adding a test that simulates upstream that flips casing would prevent regressions.

lena: agree, adding a small e2e that runs with a proxy toggle for header casing. I've added it to the ticket.

morgan: thanks all — symptoms resolved for now, will follow up in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
